I definitely recommend this app. When you first start it can seem a little bit complex, but in a day or two of using it, it will be easy.  I recommend using poster/ portrait for basically everything unless you want to do a video or something horizontal. The elements are great, my favorite font is chewy, and it is really easy to use, but you can make awesome stuff. 

One thing- if you don’t have premium then you have about %50 of the content. I have premium, but for people who don’t, I feel it makes them not want to use the app. Maybe make it so you can do more things without premium. 
Just a side note, for the zooming in and out, maybe make a bar on the slider so you know where the original was. I always loose that and then am struggling for the next 5 minutes.

This app used to have so many options that were free for us who can’t afford the subscription.
